# Brightpath Trust Center — Security Overview (excerpt)

> Fictional sample.

## Our commitment

Brightpath protects patient data with enterprise-grade security. We are SOC 2 Type II audited and HIPAA ready, and we will sign a Business Associate Agreement with healthcare customers.

## Insights ML

Insights ML uses machine learning to predict appointment no-shows. To keep our models accurate, **customer data submitted to Brightpath may be used to train and improve Brightpath models across our customer base, unless the customer opts out in writing.** Opt-out is available on Enterprise plans.

## Data retention

We retain customer data for the life of the contract and for 24 months after termination to support model quality and audit needs, after which it is deleted.
